newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ manufacturing sales up 3.5 percent in June.
newsitem.headline: NZ manufacturing sales up 3.5 percent in June.

text.p: Manufacturing sales in the June 1996 quarter increased by 3.5 percent to NZ$13.1 billion compared to the June 1995 quarter, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.

SNZ said the June quarter was a particularly good one for dairy processors, with sales up 29 percent, or NZ$300 million higher than in the June 1995 quarter, but meat processors' sales fell 2.0 percent over the same period.
